title: MFT — Integer Truncation Staking Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Integer truncation bug in `stake()` — values ≥ 2^128 are truncated to 0, but the contract records them as a large stake
code_before:
❌ truncation to uint128: values ≥ 2^128 become 0

        stakeInfo[msg.sender].amount += truncated;  // adds 0
